settings.question: What is the return policy?
settings.answer: We offer a 30-day return policy on most items. Products must be unused and in original packaging.

settings.question: Are any purchases final sale?
settings.answer: Yes, items marked final sale cannot be returned or exchanged.

settings.question: When will I get my order?
settings.answer: Most orders ship within 2–3 business days. Delivery times vary by location.

settings.question: Where are your products manufactured?
settings.answer: Our products are designed in-house and manufactured with trusted partners worldwide.

settings.question: How much does shipping cost?
settings.answer: Shipping is calculated at checkout. Free shipping may apply on qualifying orders.
